mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT oi.product_id FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED')

SELECT p.category_id AS category_id, SUM(oi.quantity) AS weight FROM ( SELECT id FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10 ) o JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN product p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category_id

SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS weight FROM ( SELECT category_id FROM user_behavior WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND event_type = 'VIEW' AND created_at >= #{since} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100 ) recent GROUP BY category_id

SELECT MIN(p.price) AS min_price, MAX(p.price) AS max_price FROM product p WHERE p.id IN ( SELECT product_id FROM user_behavior WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND event_type = 'VIEW' AND created_at >= #{since} UNION SELECT oi.product_id FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED') )

SELECT oi.product_id FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED') AND o.created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY oi.product_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC, oi.product_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM product WHERE status = 'ON_SALE' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT oi2.product_id FROM order_item oi1 JOIN orders o1 ON o1.id = oi1.order_id JOIN order_item same ON same.product_id = oi1.product_id JOIN orders o2 ON o2.id = same.order_id JOIN order_item oi2 ON oi2.order_id = o2.id AND oi2.product_id <> oi1.product_id WHERE o1.user_id = #{userId} AND o1.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED') AND o2.user_id <> #{userId} AND o2.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED') GROUP BY oi2.product_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o2.user_id) DESC, oi2.product_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
